description: This file contains implementation of the 'Communicator' class and related classes for managing RPC connections, dynamic loader paths, process shutdown handling, and proxy stub loading within the Thunder RPC framework.

classes.name: DynamicLoaderPaths
classes.description: Manages dynamic loader paths by reading configuration files and directories, providing a list of library paths.

classes.name: ProcessShutdown
classes.description: Handles process shutdown procedures, including destructors for monitorable processes, running in a dedicated thread.

classes.name: ProcessShutdownAccessor
classes.description: Provides singleton access to the ProcessShutdown instance.

methods.name: ReadList
methods.description: Recursively reads list entries from configuration files or directories, supporting include directives.

methods.name: ForceDestruct
methods.description: Forcefully destructs a process or connection by ID.

methods.name: Destruct
methods.description: Schedules a process or connection for destruction.

methods.name: WaitForCompletion
methods.description: Waits for all scheduled destructors to complete.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Returns singleton reference to the ProcessShutdown instance.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns pointer to the singleton ProcessShutdown instance.
